newsitem.title: KENYA: Share issue of Kenya's Serena opens March 24.
newsitem.headline: Share issue of Kenya's Serena opens March 24.

text.p: The initial public share offering in Kenya's Tourism Promotion Services, which operates the Serena Lodges & Hotels Ltd, will open at the Nairobi Stock Exchange on March 24 at 13 shillings per share.

The government-owned Kenya Tourism Development Corporation (KTDC) will offer for sale 9,025,100 shares or 23.3 percent of its holding in the luxury hotel chain majority owned by the Aga Khan, Serena Hotels Chief Executive Mahmud Jan Mohamed told a news conference on Thursday.

KTDC has a 33.3 percent stake in Tourism Promotion Services and will hold onto 10 percent on flotation. Tourism Promotion Services waived their pre-emptive rights in April 1996, allowing the participation of the public in the Serena ownership.

"The Serena share issue will open week commencing Monday 24th March and will close on Monday 14th April. The offer to the public is at a price of 13 shillings per share. Minimum shares one can purchase at 500," Mohamed told reporters.

Serena will become the 60th listed company on the Nairobi Stock Exchange. On Thursday, Regent Undervalued Assets Africa, incorporated in Cayman Islands, became the 59th company to be listed at the Nairobi bourse, NSE officials said.
